phases.title: Research foundation
phases.summary: A process-agnostic architecture with explicit safety boundaries.
phases.exitCriterion: Core interfaces compile and boundary tests pass.

phases.title: Fermentation digital twin
phases.summary: A reproducible process world. Baseline integration is validated; interactive control is the next step.
phases.exitCriterion: Seeded batches, trajectories, constraints, and action-conditioned transitions are reproducible.

phases.title: Control baselines
phases.summary: Compare recipe, PID, and MPC controllers under a shared protocol.
phases.exitCriterion: Recipe, PID, and MPC baselines run under one evaluation protocol.

phases.title: Scale & regime shifts
phases.summary: Understand how policies behave when simulated process dynamics change.
phases.exitCriterion: Reproducible virtual shifts expose performance degradation without claiming physical scale-up validation.

phases.title: Uncertainty & detection
phases.summary: Recognize unfamiliar conditions and quantify what the system does not know.
phases.exitCriterion: Calibration, detection, and missing/noisy-observation behavior are evaluated.

phases.title: Adaptive decision policy
phases.summary: Adapt decisions under held-out operating shifts.
phases.exitCriterion: Compare adaptation with frozen and classical baselines.

phases.title: Information as an action
phases.summary: Learn when to act, measure, experiment, wait, or escalate.
phases.exitCriterion: Compare decision choices under explicit information budgets.

phases.title: Counterfactual evaluation
phases.summary: Evaluate possible futures before proposing a decision.
phases.exitCriterion: Rank candidate decisions with uncertainty, cost, and risk.

phases.title: Experience memory
phases.summary: Turn previous batch outcomes into useful experience.
phases.exitCriterion: Cross-batch retrieval measurably improves later decisions.

phases.title: Process knowledge & LLM
phases.summary: Translate process records into traceable, typed knowledge.
phases.exitCriterion: Knowledge remains bounded; the LLM has no actuator authority.

phases.title: Full TELESTO integration
phases.summary: Connect the decision loop through safety and approval boundaries.
phases.exitCriterion: The end-to-end loop operates through constraints, safety, and human approval.

phases.title: Ablation & robustness
phases.summary: Measure the contribution of every research component.
phases.exitCriterion: Multiple seeds, held-out regimes, faults, noise, and ablations quantify contribution.

evidence.title: Seeded replay
evidence.detail: The integration tests check identical trajectories for the same seed and variation across seeds.

evidence.title: Process adapter
evidence.detail: Seven state variables and five observation channels are exposed through TELESTO-owned types.

evidence.title: Numerical integrity
evidence.detail: The wrapper checks finite values, matching trajectory lengths, and strictly increasing time.

evidence.title: Interactive control
evidence.detail: WAIT replays a precomputed trajectory. CONTROL deliberately raises NotImplementedError until actions affect future states.

evidence.title: Simulator provenance
evidence.detail: The exact upstream commit and license of the local simulator copy remain unverified.

evidence.title: Interpretation boundary
evidence.detail: Results describe a simulation testbed. Physical scale-up, plant safety, and biological validity are not established. Signed harvested product is not a validated KPI.
